title: Can't run my game project with Godot Engine v4.4.rc.custom_build
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: Godot v4.4.rc [1af42620f], 4.3.stable.

### System information

Godot v4.4.rc (1af42620f) - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - AMD Ryzen 5 2600 Six-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

in the official build, my big game project started every now and then randomly crashing instantly without the debug pause and leaves no stack trace or errors in the editor, I tried finding out what causes it but could not (removing scenes, changing code etc...).
